breve: Represents axis motions (such as joystick or analog triggers) from a gamepad.
descricao: Stores information about joystick motions. One InputEventJoypadMotion represents one axis at a time. For gamepad buttons, see InputEventJoypadButton.

propriedades.desc: Current position of the joystick on the given axis. The value ranges from -1.0 to 1.0. A value of 0 means the axis is in its resting position.
